subject: After the great furnace fire has been extinguished, an immense overturned ornate black iron cauldron lies across the rim of the bottomless ABYSS underground. An almost directly downward vertiginous view from the broken rim into pure black depth; the cauldron's heavy curved metal lip occupies the upper left foreground, snapped floor slabs on right, fine grey ash and a few last dull orange embers trace the circular opening. The chasm is overwhelmingly larger than the rim. No people, no living Morden, no falling man, no skulls, no molten lava river or active flames. This is the aftermath and unknown way forward, not the original battle memory. The far bottom must never be visible. Cool dim grey-blue air above a deep black center.
